implemented_requirements.requirement: Board definition with GO, properties, chance, jail, free parking, go‑to‑jail spaces
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py defines classes GoSpace, Property, ChanceSpace, JailSpace, FreeParkingSpace, GoToJailSpace and builds a 24‑space board in Board._build().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Property data (price, rent, group) and ownership tracking
implemented_requirements.evidence: Property class in board.py stores price, rent, group and an owner attribute; Board.owns_monopoly checks ownership.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Dice rolling (two six‑sided dice, doubles detection)
implemented_requirements.evidence: dice.py defines Dice.roll() returning two dice values, total and a boolean is_doubles.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Chance cards with actions (money, move, move_to, go_to_jail, get‑out‑of‑jail)
implemented_requirements.evidence: chancedeck.py defines CHANCE_CARDS list, ChanceCard wrapper, and ChanceDeck that shuffles and draws cards.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player model with money, position, property list, jail state, bankruptcy flag
implemented_requirements.evidence: player.py defines Player with fields money, position, properties, in_jail, jail_turns, bankrupt, and helper methods.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Turn loop that rolls dice, moves player, handles landing on spaces (buying, rent, chance, jail, free parking)
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py contains only __init__, active_players, announce, prompt and then an ellipsis placeholder; no movement, buying, rent, or chance handling logic is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Prompting players for decisions (e.g., buy property, use jail card)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.prompt method exists but is never used; there is no code that asks a player whether to purchase a landed property or to pay bail.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display of relevant game information (board state, player money, ownership)
implemented_requirements.evidence: display.py only provides a grid_coords helper; no functions to render the board, show player status, or log messages are implemented.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Free parking pot that collects fees and is awarded when landed on
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.__init__ creates self.free_parking_pot but no code ever adds to it or awards it.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Jail mechanics (go to jail, stay, pay fine, use get‑out‑of‑jail card)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player tracks jail state, but Game never moves a player to jail, processes turns in jail, or handles bail/payments.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Simplified chance card execution (apply money changes, move player, send to jail, etc.)
implemented_requirements.evidence: ChanceDeck can draw cards, but Game never draws or applies them.

critical_issues: Core game loop and movement logic are missing; players never advance on the board.
No implementation for buying properties, paying rent, or handling bankruptcy.
Chance cards are defined but never drawn or applied.
Jail and free‑parking rules are not enforced.
No user‑facing display or prompts for decisions, making the game unplayable.
The Game class ends with an ellipsis placeholder, indicating incomplete implementation.
judge.summary: The repository contains the foundational data structures (board, spaces, dice, chance deck, player) but lacks the essential engine that ties them together. Critical gameplay mechanics—turn progression, movement, property transactions, rent collection, chance handling, jail, and free‑parking—are absent. Consequently the implementation does not meet the benchmark's core requirements and is unlikely to run as a functional Monopoly‑style game.
